name: User Ratings 1.0.2.0, the Jellyfin Enhanced import: in the je sandbox as admin, the desktop layout, with the synthetic reviews.json of userratings-je-import-probe.mjs --webchecks: the kit's Jellyfin Enhanced banner above the tabs, as text; the Data tab's "Import from Jellyfin Enhanced" section with its switch-over checklist (every JE 12.14 review setting in order: user reviews To do, translation Done, the TMDB section Optional) and Use the same hiding rules; Import waits for a dry run; the dry run (one POST 202, polled) and its report as text: new ratings, one stored detached, one left out, one clamped, JE's field names, one JE member to map, no review text anywhere on the page; that member given to viewer2 and the dry run again; Import asks first (Cancel focused), then imports with the dry run's PlanToken; the report names the import's snapshot, which the run restores at the end through the API (the import undone).

steps.name: the details probe in every document (its request log and server())
the served script is 1.0.2.0
steps.message: User Ratings 1.0.2.0 is not the script the page loaded

steps.name: the users' ids
steps.script: const norm = (v) => String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v).replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase(); const u = await ApiClient.getUsers(); const id = (n) => { const x = u.find(y => y.Name === n); return x ? norm(x.Id) : null; }; const r = { admin: id('admin'), viewer: id('viewer'), viewer2: id('viewer2') }; if (!r.viewer || !r.viewer2) { throw new Error('the sandbox needs viewer and viewer2'); } return r;

steps.name: the Data tab mounted: the snapshots, the users and the jobs read, and the detached list
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = __jfurDetails.requests.slice(window.__mark); const got = (p) => r.some(x => x.method === 'GET' && x.path === p && x.status === 200); return !document.querySelector('#UserRatingsData').classList.contains('hide') && !!document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot .jfur-data-export') && !!document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDetachedListRoot .jfur-det') && got('/UserRatings/Admin/Snapshots') && got('/UserRatings/Admin/Diagnostics') && got('/UserRatings/Admin/Jobs') && got('/UserRatings/Admin/Detached'); })()

steps.name: the time the lists take to draw
GETs only (and the page's own Detached/Seen): opening the tab writes nothing
no select in the Data tab or the detached list (the TV layout's D-pad and OK work on every control)
the kit's Jellyfin Enhanced banner above the tabs, as text
steps.assert: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#UserRatingsBanners .userRatingsBanner')).some(b => b.textContent.indexOf("Jellyfin Enhanced's User Reviews is on.") === 0 && b.children.length === 0)

steps.name: the switch-over checklist: every JE 12.14 review setting, in order, as the sandbox's JE has them

eleven items; user reviews on, so To do; translation off with no URL or key, so Done; the TMDB section Optional; the activity feed off (JE's default), so Show recently reviewed Done (0.3.22); none Unknown; Use the same hiding rules shown
Import waits for a dry run
dry: the report
steps.waitFor: document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot .jfur-data-je-section .jfur-data-je-report').textContent.indexOf("Dry run, nothing was changed. Jellyfin Enhanced's file has 8 reviews.") === 0

steps.name: dry: the counts, the field names, the JE member to map
steps.eval: ({ counts: Array.from(document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot .jfur-data-je-section .jfur-data-je-report').querySelectorAll('[data-jfur-count]')).map(li => li.getAttribute('data-jfur-count')), fields: document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot .jfur-data-je-section .jfur-data-je-report').querySelector('.jfur-data-je-fields').textContent, unknown: document.querySelectorAll('#UserRatingsDataRoot [data-jfur-je-user]').length, text: document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot').textContent.indexOf('jeimp-') >= 0, markup: document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot .jfur-data-je-section .jfur-data-je-report').querySelectorAll('b, i').length })

steps.name: dry: new ratings, a review stored detached, one left out and one clamped; JE's field names; one JE member to map; no review text anywhere on the page
steps.assert: ['Created', 'StoredDetached', 'Invalid', 'Clamped'].every(k => __vars.dry.counts.indexOf(k) >= 0) && __vars.dry.fields === "Fields in Jellyfin Enhanced's file: UserId, TmdbId, MediaType, Content, Rating, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt" && __vars.dry.unknown === 1 && !__vars.dry.text && __vars.dry.markup === 0

steps.name: dry: the tab's requests since the mark
steps.eval: __jfurDetails.requests.slice(window.__mark).map(r => ({ method: r.method, path: r.path, query: r.query, status: r.status }))

steps.name: dry: one POST of the import, a dry run
steps.assert: (() => { const p = __vars.dryRequests.filter(x => x.method === 'POST'); return p.length === 1 && p[0].path === '/UserRatings/Admin/Import/JellyfinEnhanced' && p[0].status === 202 && /dryRun=true/.test(JSON.stringify(p[0].query || '')); })()

steps.name: map: the JE member given to viewer2
steps.script: const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#UserRatingsDataRoot [data-jfur-je-user] .jfur-data-choice')).find(x => x.textContent === 'viewer2'); if (!b) { throw new Error('no viewer2 choice'); } b.click(); return true;

steps.name: map: Import waits for another dry run
map: the report again, Import on
import: the question, the focus on Cancel
import: the question: a snapshot first, its restore the undo
steps.assert: __vars.jeQuestion.text.indexOf("Import Jellyfin Enhanced's reviews as the dry run showed? A snapshot of the ratings as they are now is taken first; restoring it undoes the import.") >= 0

steps.name: import: imported, the report names the import's snapshot
steps.waitFor: !document.querySelector('.jfur-panel[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]') && document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot .jfur-data-je-section .jfur-data-je-report').textContent.indexOf('Imported.') === 0 && document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot .jfur-data-je-section .jfur-data-je-report').textContent.indexOf('The ratings from just before were kept as userratings-import-') >= 0

steps.name: import: the tab's requests since the mark
steps.eval: __jfurDetails.requests.slice(window.__mark).map(r => ({ method: r.method, path: r.path, query: r.query, status: r.status }))

steps.name: import: one real run with the dry run's PlanToken
steps.assert: (() => { const p = __vars.importRequests.filter(x => x.method === 'POST'); const q = JSON.stringify(p.length ? p[0].query : ''); return p.length === 1 && /dryRun=false|"dryRun":"false"/.test(q) && /ifPlan=[0-9a-f]{32}|"ifPlan":"[0-9a-f]{32}"/.test(q) && p[0].status === 202; })()

steps.name: clean: the import undone: its snapshot restored through the API
steps.script: const r = await __jfurDetails.server('POST', 'UserRatings/Admin/Snapshots/Restore?name=' + encodeURIComponent(__vars.jeSnapshot)); if (r.status !== 200) { throw new Error('restore ' + r.status); } return r.status;
